claims.claim: Infleqtion announced on September 24 that it achieved 30 entangled logical qubits, converting the prior 2026 logical-qubit target from a forward milestone into an issuer-reported technical achievement; this reduces one technical execution uncertainty but does not by itself establish customer economics or scalable commercial utility.

Customer concentration is a source-addressed commercial risk: 2025 disclosures state two customers represented 60% and 12% of revenue, while government contracting exposes sales to procurement, budget and policy changes.

Q2 liquidity remained substantial, but operating cash flow included a $27.4M temporary payroll-tax working-capital benefit and underlying operating cash burn was approximately $14M; proposed Commerce funding remains conditional and contemplates government equity, so funding announcements should not be treated as realized recurring revenue or dilution-free capital.

risks.risk: High historical customer concentration and government-contract exposure can make revenue sensitive to a small number of programs, procurement cycles and budget decisions.
Conditional public funding and contemplated government equity can support commercialization while introducing approval, timing and dilution uncertainty.
Logical-qubit progress reduces a technical milestone risk but customer utility and economics remain separate successor bottlenecks.

contradictions.contradiction: The 30-logical-qubit milestone has advanced from target to issuer-reported achievement, while scalable customer economics remain unverified.
contradictions.disposition: technical uncertainty reduced; commercial-utility uncertainty remains and should be separated rather than treated as contradiction requiring Beta blockage

unknowns.unknown: Current 2026 customer concentration and contract-level gross-margin economics remain to be quantified by Alpha from source-addressed financial disclosures.
